mapper.select: SELECT CAST(n.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(n.recipient_account_id AS CHAR) AS recipientAccountId,CAST(n.actor_account_id AS CHAR) AS actorAccountId, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname,''),m.username,'') AS actorName,CAST(m.avatar_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS actorAvatarAttachmentId, n.type,CAST(n.biz_id AS CHAR) AS bizId,CAST(n.thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,t.title AS threadTitle,n.title,n.summary, DATE_FORMAT(n.read_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS readAt,DATE_FORMAT(n.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM forum_notification n LEFT JOIN forum_member m ON m.account_id=n.actor_account_id LEFT JOIN forum_thread t ON t.id=n.thread_id WHERE n.recipient_account_id=#{accountId} AND n.type=#{type} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND n.read_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_notification WHERE recipient_account_id=#{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL
SELECT type,COUNT(*) AS count FROM forum_notification WHERE recipient_account_id=#{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL GROUP BY type
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_notification SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,NOW()) WHERE id=#{id} AND recipient_account_id=#{accountId}
UPDATE forum_notification SET read_at=NOW() WHERE recipient_account_id=#{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL
